rest_image: appearance*4+640; fixed down-facing source image, no direction lookup
grid_record_xy: 8*x-160-(8 if right neighbor within width has nonzero low10 else0)
rest_actor_gate: assigned staff slot, staff state byte+40==0, x!=-1,y!=-1
record_build_order: grid row-major top-to-bottom/left-to-right, then resting staff slot2,1,0
packet_cpu_order: actor records last-to-first at OT depth9
ot_link_order: head insertion reconstructs actor record order0..n-1 in this OT bucket
interpolation: None in these normal actor image/coordinate expressions or84830 packet emission. Global draw origin remains an input.

normal_tail: if branch taken and cd7f4==0:23438 simulation update
timing.input_state: 13DDC updates current/previous logical input and rising edges; cd9cc is the previous snapshot after that helper
timing.rule: Holding nonzero logical input across first draw prevents this tail from entering simulation-update branch. If input changes during second draw, that gate is not rechecked before23438.
timing.wall_clock: Two draw calls in the uncomplicated tail are not a measured fixed frame rate. Extra UI/audio draws and waits exist; do not assign a global pixels-per-second constant from this alone.

limitations: No original game CPU execution or new game-state trace in this work.
No claim that every UI, cutscene, customer variant or hardware path has no animation.
Original TIM only supplies four direction tiles per identified appearance; synthesized footstep frames would be remake additions.
